messages:
Rae: Little plant at desk 23 reached a new leaf milestone today. Photos? :seedling:
Devon: Pic incoming. It now judges my keyboard crumbs.
Priya: Official name suggestion: Sir Photos-a-Lot.
Kai: Vote: Sir Photos-a-Lot, Fernie Sanders, or Leaf Zeppelin? :guitar:
Rae: @Priya +1 for Sir Photos-a-Lot.
Devon: Fernie Sanders is a strong political play.
Priya: Leaf Zeppelin is peak energy.
Devon: SnackBot: Plant watering reminder set for Friday 9am. :bell:
SnackBot: Reminder: Water plants every 5 days unless it's a cactus.
Kai: Quick one-liner contest while we're here: best plant pun gets a sticker on their mug.
Rae: "Photosynthesis? More like photo-simply my new coworker."
Priya: "Leaf me alone, I'm thriving."
Devon: "Our plant has great 'stalk' power." :joy:
Kai: Winner decided: sticker goes to Devon for sheer pun audacity. :tada:
Rae: Kudos to the plant for morale boost. Also, please don't repot on a meeting day.
Priya: Agreed. Also tiny watering team sign-up in #ops if you want to help.
Devon: I'll water and sing quietly.
SnackBot: New message: Office trivia night Friday 7pm — sign up: https://tiny.redwood/trivia
Rae: Tra-la-la watering choir, I love it. :notes:
